summary: The Metaverse and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are rapidly shaping the next iteration of human experience. Metaverse, MetaIntelligence and Infinite Worlds with AI brings together leading scholars to explore how immersive worlds are transforming education, healthcare, identity, governance, creativity, and digital economies. This diverse collection of chapters, spanning immersive learning, adaptive digital twins, AI-based meta-universities, digital travel, embodied presence, ethical metaverse design, and next-generation virtual health, offers a multidisciplinary view of an emerging digital civilization. Bridging theory, practice, and global case studies, the book examines the profound social, ethical, and cultural questions raised as AI becomes the cognitive engine of virtual worlds. It provides essential insights for educators, policymakers, technologists, innovators, and researchers seeking to understand the future of life, work, and learning in the intelligent Metaverse. This book is a comprehensive, timely, and necessary guide to one of the most transformative technological frontiers of our century.
